message: Statement: We're focused on delivering value to our customers at a competitive price. With no demand data yet, I'll set a moderate price above cost to learn how the market responds. Price:2.50

Statement: We're pricing independently based on our own costs and observed demand, and I'll adjust modestly toward what the market data supports.  Last round's profit of 10.88 at 2.50 against a rival at 2.00 suggests healthy margins, but the rival's lower price is pulling some volume. I'll trim my price slightly to defend share while keeping a solid markup. Price:2.30
Last round the rival priced above me and I earned a solid margin, so I'll nudge my price up modestly to capture more margin while still leaving room to stay competitive on volume. Price:2.30

Statement: I'm pricing independently off my own cost and demand data, and will make a small adjustment based on how sales responded at 2.30.
